envelope.description: Prove the merge with real git clones

body.title: Prove the merge with real git clones
body.summary: Add the real-git tests: two clones that append different log and feedback entries to one artifact merge with no conflict and a reader sees every entry once in order, and two clones that change the same head conflict in git while the line files of the same merge still union.
acceptanceChecks: a merge of two branches that appended different log and feedback entries completes with no conflict and the reader returns every entry once, in timestamp then id order
a head changed on both branches makes git report a conflict, and the sidecar files of that merge are still unioned
the tests skip cleanly when git is not available

tests.name: sidecar-merge.test.ts: two clones that append different log and feedback entries to one artifact merge with no conflict and a reader sees every entry once, in timestamp then id order
sidecar-merge.test.ts: a head changed in two clones conflicts in git and the line files of the same merge still union
